_doc: Stick World vocabulary (BuzzcafStudio docs/STICK_WORLD_PLAN.md). The ONE source for eras and outfit pieces: StickScene.tsx imports it, presentation/motion_stick.py reads it, the Studio keeps a byte-identical copy at backend/integrations/stick_world.json pinned by a test. Every piece name is unique across body/head/held/hair, so an outfit spec is order-free tokens joined by '+', e.g. 'chiton+laurel+scroll+beard'. A figure wears at most one piece of each category.
